description: Defines a thread-safe, bounded object pool implementation with support for metrics collection, object reclamation, and various storage strategies (raw pointers, unique_ptr, reference counting). Includes internal classes for segments, object reclaimers, and metrics collectors.

classes.name: bounded_object_pool_metrics_collector
classes.description: Helper class to collect pool metrics, with specialization for enabled/disabled metrics.

classes.name: bounded_object_pool_impl
classes.description: Implements core logic of the bounded object pool, including segment management, object allocation, and reclamation.

classes.name: bounded_object_pool
classes.description: Main class providing a thread-safe object pool with raw object pointers.

classes.name: bounded_unique_object_pool
classes.description: Object pool storing objects as unique_ptr, allowing polymorphic object storage.

classes.name: bounded_rc_object_pool
classes.description: Reference-counted object pool supporting shared ownership semantics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool, returning a RAII wrapper.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of objects the pool can hold.

methods.name: size_approx
methods.description: Estimates the current number of allocated objects.

methods.name: are_metrics_active
methods.description: Checks if metrics collection is active.

methods.name: nof_alloc_reattempts
methods.description: Returns the number of allocation reattempts recorded.

methods.name: nof_scanned_segments
methods.description: Returns the number of scanned segments during allocation attempts.
